Plain Brik

(No 'C' cus c is for cookie)

Teams:
Monks (White)
Daedra (Red)

Loadout:
Stone Sword
Bow 
Diamond Pickaxe [Eff. I]
Golden Apple [2]

Aim of this map:
Basically, I focus on plain aesthetically but I aim for a possibly effective.

Features:
Enchanting
Portals (Not many, just an easier way to get to the mon from the side paths)
